I withdrew the finding, and the verdict was accepted. A generic register test does cover reset values on these blocks.

The shared `hw/dv/tools/dvsim/tests/csr_tests.hjson` defines `{name}_csr_hw_reset`, which runs the common vseq with `+csr_hw_reset`. The AES, HMAC and KMAC sim configs all import that file. I didn't open the sequence source itself. That it reads every register and compares it to the reset value in the register model comes from my knowledge of the DV library, not from this repo.

The finding didn't name a block, so I checked these three, which come from the recent commit.
